name: rimLighting
description: Properties for configuring stylized, light-aware rim lighting. The rim is shaped by the view angle and can be constrained by the primary directional light color and direction.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Selects the rim lighting mode. Off skips the rim lighting calculation. Camera uses a view-angle rim. Light Direction constrains the rim to the light-facing side. Inverted Light Direction constrains it to the side facing away from the primary directional light.

properties.name: tint
properties.description: Tint applied to the primary directional light color to produce the final rim color. Color is displayed as sRGB but the values are stored as linear color.

properties.name: intensity
properties.description: Brightness multiplier for the rim highlight. A value of 0 removes the visible rim even when the feature is enabled.

properties.name: power
properties.description: Controls the silhouette falloff. Lower values create a broader rim; higher values keep the rim tighter to the silhouette.
